title: Ms. Koizumi Loves Ramen Noodles 2016 Nenmatsu SP

overview: New adventures of a ramen-loving girl Koizumi who gets the opportunity to try a special ramen the way it is made in Germany and also has to deal with popularity after one of her friends posts a video on YouTube about her.
